h: Something stirs behind the eyes of the Kukutha. They are given the spark
The Drushouna go extinct after 700 years
The Zygethi (giant temperate grazers) branch off from the Sofama
A volcano erupts in the wilderness
The Krariaae go extinct after 23,000 years
The Hiamami learn to speak, tame fire, and bury their dead
